description: Land Title Settlement Department - Settlement Orders No. 208 (Nuwaraeliya) Galauda, Hanguranketha D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District in Block Survey Topo Plan No. 15 (Central)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement orders under the Land Settlement Ordinance, specifically addressing the final settlement of multiple land lots in Nuwaraeliya District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, and the parties on whom they are settled (either the State or named individuals), making it primarily concerned with land and property matters.
